Watch: Keep an eye on NVDA's scanner setup (BUY 9/12, entry 225.07-224.85, stop 224.51) as a potential indicator for the chip sector.
Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and watching key tech names for potential shifts.
plays: Trim SOXL: It's a SELL signal and leveraged decay is a major concern on margin.
Trim SPAL: Similar to SOXL, this leveraged ETF needs attention given its SELL status and PnL.
